patch_description:
This revision uses a robust, endpoint-aligned quadratic local regression combined with an adaptive alpha-beta predictor. The quadratic endpoint estimate reduces phase delay around genuine curved turns, while a Huber reweighting pass limits impulse and outlier influence.

The tracker uses separate thresholds for ordinary direction maintenance and counter-trend entry. Established trends require stronger, persistent opposing slope evidence before velocity is allowed to reverse. The reversal threshold is additionally increased as a trend matures, reducing short noise-driven reversals without preventing confirmed sustained turns. Adaptive gains remain responsive during coherent movement while using lower gains in quiet, noisy regions.
